description: Na₂MgFe₄O₇ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.73 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.75 Å. Mg is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four FeO₆ octahedra, corners with three FeO₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with two FeO₆ octahedra, and  a faceface with one FeO₄ trigonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-49°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.16 Å. There are four inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted FeO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with six FeO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one MgO₅ trigonal bipyramid,  a cornercorner with one FeO₄ trigonal pyramid, and  a faceface with one MgO₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 60-85°. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.25 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted FeO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two FeO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids,  a cornercorner with one FeO₄ trigonal pyramid, and edges with two FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-41°. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.05 Å. In the third Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids, corners with four FeO₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with three equivalent FeO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one MgO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one FeO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.35 Å. In the fourth Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids, corners with four FeO₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with three equivalent FeO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one MgO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one FeO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.28 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Mg and three Fe atoms to form distorted OMgFe₃ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂Fe₃ square pyramids and corners with two equivalent ONa₂MgFe₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Mg and three Fe atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and two Fe atoms to form ONa₂MgFe₂ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₂Fe₃ square pyramid, corners with two equivalent OMgFe₃ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Fe₃ square pyramid. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and three Fe atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two Na and three Fe atoms to form distorted ONa₂Fe₃ square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent OMgFe₃ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂MgFe₂ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂MgFe₂ trigonal bipyramid. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na and three Fe atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and three Fe atoms.
